svg.title: rigol-mcp: From the editor to the oscilloscope
svg.desc: GitHub Copilot in VS Code communicates with rigol-mcp over MCP and stdio. The server communicates with a Rigol DHO814 over SCPI and Ethernet. Measurements and captures return along the same connections. The scope is shown using the supplied product image.

g.text: From the editor to the oscilloscope.
Ask a question. Capture a signal. Work with the measurements.
